summary: Mobilicom Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing its participation in the U.S. Department of Defense exercise Northern Strike 2026. The press release describes joint demonstrations with Reverent Networks from August 5-7, 2026, showcasing secure connectivity and autonomy solutions for drones and robotics. There are no transaction terms, no price, no parties buying or selling assets, and no corporate-event-related special situation. This is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16, akin to a standard operational update or press release filing. No special-situation category applies.
